news_cards.title: APEDA ne Bihar se Australia ke liye GI-tagged Mithila Makhana ka pehla samudri niryat kiya
bullets: APEDA ne Bihar se Australia ke liye GI-tagged Mithila Makhana ka niryat kiya hai
Yeh pehla mauka hai jab Mithila Makhana ko samudri route se niryat kiya gaya hai
Is niryat se Bihar ke kisanon ko labh hoga aur unki aay mein vriddhi hogi

news_cards.title: Tamil Nadu ko ang pradaan ke liye Best State ka puraskar mila
bullets: Tamil Nadu ko ang pradaan ke liye Best State ka puraskar mila hai
Yeh puraskar Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare Anupriya Patel dwara diya gaya hai
Tamil Nadu ne ang pradaan mein mahatvapoorn yogdan diya hai
